# sdv-py real captures for the parser-parity harness

Real API response bodies copied from sportsdataverse-py at the vendor pin
`719de79edb685b89c524f8b4c0c146fea0b53855` (`tools/codegen/vendor.yaml` `source.ref`).
No synthetic payloads: each file is the sdv-py capture byte for byte, and a
`*.gz` file is that capture gzipped (`gzip -9 -n`; byte-identical after
gunzip) to keep the repo small. Capture dates, request URLs and any trimming are
in the README of the sdv-py source directory named below.

- `manifest.yaml`: capture -> the endpoint it verifies (also lists captures
  already vendored under `../on3`, `../asa`, `../mls_api`, `../nwsl_api`, `../nba_stats`,
  `../sports247`).
  The fixture-to-endpoint mapping follows sdv-py's `tools/codegen/native_fixture_map.yaml`
  (MLB Stats, NHL api-web / EDGE / Records / Stats REST) and the provenance READMEs
  for the other families.
- `oracle/<family>.json.gz`: sdv-py's own parser output on each capture (columns,
  polars dtypes, row count, first 20 rows), generated by `tools/parity/py_oracle.py`
  with sdv-py checked out at the pin. Regenerate it whenever a capture is added or the
  pin moves.
- `parity_coverage.json`: per family, the documented / verified / unverified /
  incompatible counts and the verified endpoints (written by the harness with
  `SDV_PARITY_WRITE=1`, drift-checked otherwise). Generated row types key on it.
- `test/parsers/parity.test.js` is the harness.

Not vendored: captures whose parse is empty in both languages (nothing to verify),
and `mlb_statcast/leaderboard_xstats.csv` (a hand-written one-row stub, not a capture).
